'''Krom Rethway''' was a flabby-necked [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]]. When [[Darth Caedus]] approached the Moff Council on [[Nickel One]], he was one of many who wanted nothing to do with Caedus or the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. His opinion would matter little however, as he was killed during the [[Second Battle of Roche]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] sent to kill the Moff Council.
